company_info.company_description: "Ben has been installing solar since 2005, therefore we only offer brands we know and trust will stand up to the test of time, with warranties be dealt with quickly in the unlikely event of failure.Off-grid specialistsOn-grid battery specialistsEV Charger specialistsNETCC signatoryTesla Certified InstallersSMA PowerUp dealer - VIP Service and Support and free extended warranty on Sunny Boy InvertersFronius Service Partner - VIP Service and SupportFinances options availableOffering air conditioning and general electrical servicesWe recommend site inspections with our friendly team to ensure everything runs smoothly on installation day, to ensure a comprehensive quote and no extras."

reviews.review_description: Sales/quoting process was very easy and James listened to our needs, concerns and plans and quoted accordingly.  He even raised some issues we hadn't thought of.

From the first telephone contact to the quoting process to the installation and commissioning of our Solar panels and battery nothing was a bother to all of the staff at Expert Electrical from start to finish. I can highly recommend their customer service and workmanship.

Excellent as always - Caleb's team were professional allround.This is the second time we've called on expert electrical - this time to upgrade to home battery and EV charger with extra roof panels.Always courteous, neat and tidy work and ready to answer any questions I had.

No issues with quote and institution. Fantastic team and service. Arrived on time on the day organised and quick quality install. Love the Sigenergy system and battery. Would highly recommend Expert Electrical.

We decided to go ahead with Expert Electrical for a few reasons. 1. Lee who came to our house was a really good sales rep who educated us in solar systems like none of the other reps did. He went through thoroughly what would be best for our living situation and our home. 2. The price was within our budget and comparable to other companies that didn't even bother making a visit. 3. Installation date was not too far in the future. We were lucky though as they called us when they got a cancellation and we got it all installed about a week or two after we signed the contract.We're super happy with the solar system Expert Electrical installed, their customer service, price and communication. Highly recommend anyone looking for solar to use Expert Electrical.
Very good engagement of sales through product selection and finally installation

Expert Electrical were the only company willing to give us a quote months from our house being built. Every other company ignored us, or said come back a month from completion and weren't willing to engage.The team were friendly, and communication was amazing from beginning to end. Answered all questions and gave honest recommendations.We couldn't get our solar installed the week of move in, but as we had an EV they came and installed the charger early for no additional cost. We also had a two and a half day installation quote for the solar, they had to cancel the initial install due to staffing issues. On the next date they could attend they sent out three teams to get the install done in under a day.Have more electrical work and a battery to be installed, will be using them for all the work.

I am very thankful that I went ahead with Expert Electrical. I contacted quite a few installers for quotes. Expert Electrical accurately identified my requirements and provided the right product for the job. My initial quotation phase was done before the battery rebate, once the battery rebate was revealed Expert Electrical postponed the install to allow myself the option to make adjustments. This clearly shows they aim to put the customer first. During this postponement they adjusted the system to fit a few extra panels which was a pleasant surprise. Yes there were extensive delays with install and commissioning, this was by no means their fault as the battery rebate has caused chaos in the industry with supply chain disruptions that are out of installers control. The install of the system was clean and professional.Thank you again Expert Electrical.David Donnelly
Great team, excellent communication from start to finish. Very impressed at the quality and speed of the installation

We had to go completely off grid as it was going to cost over 200k to get connected.  Scott was able to show us equivalent houses and what they have experienced in real time in the dead of winter.  It gave us confidence that we won’t need to be worried about our consumption except for a few days a year.Quoting was easy, install was great.  Zero issues.

Expert Electrical installed ducted air conditioning and a solar/battery system in our house and we couldn't be happier. The quotation process was smooth - Matthew was super helpful and incredibly patient with all my questions! Martina made the booking process extremely easy and communicated everything clearly to me.When it came time for the installation, Caleb and the team turned up on time, were very respectful, clean and friendly and the work was done to a very high standard. There was a miscommunication about the location of one of the vents, but the guys were extremely apologetic and organized a tradesman to come and repair the hole the same day - we can't even see where it was! Caleb and the guys were great to work with and they completed all the work in less time than quoted. I can't recommend them enough!

We are absolutely thrilled with our new solar and battery backup installation from Expert Electrical. I had been obsessing over trying to find the right installer for a few weeks already, when I got in touch with Expert Electrical. Right from the start with them the whole process was just wonderful. The sales guy was very personable and informative and helpful and he was extremely responsive. We got a great quote for an exciting system, and talking to their main installer Caleb about various specific details also instilled a lot of confidence that we had made the right choice.On the day of the install, Caleb and his team were really efficient. All on the same day they removed our old solar system and installed the newer larger solar system (28 Aiko panels) and battery backup (24 kWh from Sigenergy). Everybody on the team was really nice and polite and the install looks really tidy.They also took care of all the paperwork, and all the rebates were already calculated into the final amount to pay, so it was all super easy. We were also provided with instructions on how to use the system and ample documentation, including photos of some of the installation details.In our case, the added benefit is also that they have their business very close to where we live.

We recently had solar installed and couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team was friendly, reasonably priced, and incredibly helpful throughout the installation and setup. They took the time to answer our questions and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend
Quote was reasonableAll our questions (many) were patiently explainedThe installation on time and efficient
Easy to contact and arrange installation by the friendly and efficient team.  Competitive price and good service so we are satisfied with the package of services provided by Expert Electrical.

These guys were top notch for my solar install.From quoting to installation and turning the system on, all was done very professionally and quickly.The guys were great to deal with and very respectful, pricing was good, and all around I'm very happy with them.I've actually had them back to install AC in the house. Can certainly recommend

Very straightforward process from the initial quote to installation. Caleb and the team were punctual and tidy, they got the job done faster than expected. The admin team were communicative and transparent as to what needed to occur. The team was accomodating with the uncertainty of a future battery rebate and we quickly arrived at an agreement that worked for both parties.

What a great company to deal with. From Lee who put together the quote for our solar array, Martina in the office (who was great when I called to check some details) through to James (?) and crew who installed the solar. Install was scheduled for a Saturday but got installed on the Thursday before. I Highly recommend this company.
Willing to go above and beyond. Even bad weather (cyclone) didn’t put them off wanting to install the new system for me.

From the quoting process right through to installation, Expert Electrical have provided excellent service at an affordable price. They have been prompt and professional at each stage of the process and have been very helpful in answering any questions. I would definitely recommend!
Great customer service. Communication was good. Price on par with other companies. Very easy to deal with. No mess after installation.

Quick quote without any pushy sales behaviour. Good communication and proactively called to organise installed. Turned up on time for the install and caused minimal disruption. System is working well.

We went through expert electrical for our solar installation. They were fantastic and answered all our many questions. They were able to get the solar installed quickly and they were reasonably priced. I would highly recommend them

The knowledgeable team at Expert Electrical made the whole process stress free. They were very professional & polite & efficient, from discussing my solar needs with Tim at the quoting stage / organising payments and install dates during such a busy Christmas period to Installation day with Caleb.
Great company to deal with. Excellent communication. Installers were punctual, tidy and polite. Highly recommend.

I can highly recommend Expert Electrical for your new solar installation. From consultation with Lee, office liaison with Martina through to installation with Caleb and his crew. It was easy, informative and professional. Pricing, product knowledge, customer service, installation and Q&A’s; everything was a breeze. Thank you Expert Electrical.

Awesome sales guy Lee, he wasn’t pushy, he was helpful and communicative. No constant pestering when i needed time to decide, really good bloke.Installation by Caleb and his team was great, they were efficient and tidy. Very helpful in setting up the connection and helping me with the app.

Expert Electrical exceeded my expectations at every step - from providing a comprehensive quote to navigating the complexities of Feed in Tariff, right through to the seamless installation. Particular highlights were the additional pieces of work, removing an old wood burner chimney from the roof and expertly handled an ongoing pigeon problem at my property, including some near vomiting moments from the guys, taking extra care to clean and protect the work area from bird droppings and cleaning the roof before starting the install work. Their team even offered helpful advice about preventing future issues with birds nesting near the electrical installations. What truly sets them apart is their exceptional professionalism and how well their team worked and communicated. In today's business environment, it's rare to find a company where every team member is so engaged and customer-focused. They took the time to explain everything clearly and ensured the area was spotless after completing the work, including removing all traces of bird mess along with their usual cleanup. I'll definitely be using their services again and highly recommend them to anyone needing solar installations and electrical work done, especially if you're dealing with challenging situations like pest birds around your property. They're problem-solvers who go above and beyond!

We were recommended to ring this company.From our first contact they were prompt in organising a visit to sort out the best system for our needs.This all happened so quick and from the office girl expert salesman to the team who came out to install.We are so grateful for their service and professionalism.To make sure we got our system installed due to weather.They sent a team of 5 out .

We couldn't be happier with the whole process!The communication was awesome from Lee providing the quote and working with us to get the best system to suit our needs and Martina in the office always ready to answer any questions we had.The installation team were so efficient. Dante and Caleb kept us informed as to what they were doing the entire time.The boys left the site clean, tidy and other than the system being in you wouldn't have known they were there

Easy process from the early stage of quoting to the actual installation.On the day the team removed our old faulty system and installed the new 13.2 Kw system without any issues.Great to see how much power we are now generating to power the 2 houses on our property.Cant recommend highly enough A+

Expert Electrical installed our solar system in our previous home and after moving to a new home we chose to use them again without hesitation. The total work carried out included:- removal of old rooftop hot water system- install of 13kw of solar panels and inverter- install of heat pump hot water system- install of air conditioner and two ceiling fansThe work was carried out as scheduled, on time and on budget, and we have experienced no issues with workmanship or quality. This is the second time we have used Expert Electrical and if we ever need another solar system or battery in the future we will use them again.

Quotes and advice was great the team at EE listened to what we wanted and didn’t try to talk us into what we don’t want like a lot of other companies do.EE kept us up to date and arranged install dates as soon they had a date for the parts arriving.Guys were super friendly very professional the way they installed and managed the whole job.Very happy customer

Quoting and sales process was seamless, Expert Electrical attended site and discussed the options and also talked about emerging electrical advancements which is great to know they are keeping up to date.Installation was on time with no issues, staff were very professional and I often laughed at hearing the seniors engage the juniors in their training.Explanation and guidance was given but I am technical and pick things up quickly so could work everything out.Overall great experience from quoting to getting in communication with Origin and Energex due to being an embedded network and then the install all working no issues.

Quoting inspection was done with prompt follow up with documentation that was clear and easy to follow.Installation personnel were very polite and efficient with the whole installation. site left clean and tidy.Instructions given to allow charge rate of solar panels to be followed at any time.Would highly recommend this team (and have already done so)

From Quote to instillation the team provided everything we were after. Any questions we had were answered promptly with detailed information. This information assisted us in choosing the system/panels and layout that suited our home.
Very professional service from sales through to the installation. Highly recommend after the service that we have received from other installers and sales people.

Expert Electrical installed my original system over 12 months ago. No hesitation in going back to them when I decided to extend a month or so ago. Quote process was very efficient, communication around arranging installation was timely and the installation was very efficient on the day. Walked me through the extra pieces (Watt Pilot EV Charger) and how it all worked.

Lee was the person who came to see my property, and provided me with a quote. Lee was very professional, and friendly. He was easy to communicate with, took the time to listen to what I had in mind, and provided solutions to them.The installers were Caleb and team, they were amazing all around. There was a missed day due to part of the team being unwell, but they made up for it, and still did a great job. Caleb and team were professional, friendly, and polite. They kept a very tidy worksite, and the clean up after was good too. After the installation of my solar they explained what to expect afterwards, and also showed me the app that will work with my solar energy system.The grid connection was organised by Expert Electrical, and they also kept me informed of the process, and what I need to do in terms of contacting my energy provider to notify and confirm with them that I have installed solar on my property.On the whole I am very impressed with their work, and would highly recommend them to anyone seeking to have solar installed.
The installation was fast and great, all completed within the day. Excellent communication and follow up.

Expert Electrical have been brilliant throughout the whole process of replacing our old 1.5kw system. They were very quick to reach out and organise a time to quote. Lee was very knowledgeable and listened to what we wanted and was able to provide multiple quotes as we didn’t know if we wanted a battery or not. Once we accepted we were booked in for installation within a month.Caleb and the team were very professional and did a great job with the installation. Caleb set up the app and showed us how to use it. It is great being able to monitor our consumption for the first time. We have had a few questions after installation and they have been very prompt in responding.The whole process has been seamless and we are very happy we went with Expert Electrical.
All my dealing with Expert Electrical have been 1st class..Their staff were friendly and effiicien,.Pricing was competitive. and installation went very well

We have had an excellent experience with expert electrical. From the get-go, Joran established a great rapport with us with timely email and phone contact to get the quote customised to our electrical needs, roof space for pannels and future proofing with suggested types of inverters.The installation team was punctual, tidy, and professional. We rely on tank water for drinking and have high standards of cleanliness which they meet. They did 2 days of hard work all always easy to deal with. A special thanks to James Cameron and the other boys who I can't recall there names for going up and down the ladder on a 2story house with 74 panels and racking.The whole expert electrical team were great. The staff from the office and installation team simplified the process of registering the system with energex and setting up the apps to get the most of ouf the solar system.

The Expert Electrical team have been fantastic!Lee was very professional and informative during the quoting phase and coped with all my requests.Martina and Emma have been very helpful and supportive with applications and admin processes.Caleb and his team were on time, very polite and efficient during installation and commissioning and how to use the monitoring app.Whilst not the cheapest nor most expensive Expert Electrical have provided the system I needed at a reasonable price.I highly recommend Expert Electrical to anyone considering a solar installation

I had to replace my existing system, but wanted to keep my old Tarrif. Expert Electrical went above and beyond to liaise with my power supplier to determine the maximum system configuration I could have without losing my feed in tarrif. And then they beat the competition on price! Great installation with little wait time. Highly recommended!
The installation was done in an expert manner, and was smoothly operated.

The team at Expert Electrical are really top notch. From the first sales call to the installation the team was awesome. Happy to answer any questions and provide guidance. Caleb and his installation team really take pride in their work and it shows.
From start to finish was prompt and professional, made my booking and was shocked to have installed so quicklyThe system is working great and the team couldn’t be more helpful
The team was great. Good communication & work was done well. Very happy.

The team were fantastic, the job was done very quickly after accepting the quotation.On the day the team arrived on time had the job complete and they even took away all the rubbish etcThe solar system and battery installation looks great and is already doing great.I would highly recommend the team at Expert Electrical

From the initial quoting stage, Francis from Expert Electrical was more concerned with how we were using electricity in our house rather than just trying to sell us a solar system. This was quite refreshing and a real point of difference in the quoting process. Discussions on better ways to limit grid usage combined with an appropriately sized solar system has seen a sizable reduction in our power drawn from the grid.Expert Electrical were happy to provide quotes for multiple inverter brands and explained their panel recommendation in simple terms.Installation was within 2 weeks which was great.The installers ( Maurice and crew ) arrived on time and were extremely professional and had the system up in no time. There were no issues with my desired inverter location (garage) and went beyond to make sure it was installed there.Maurice was very apologetic when he discovered the inverter was dead on arrival, but had a  replacement inverter installed within 3 working days.The system is currently performing above my expectations and would happily recommend Expert Electrical.

I recently had a complete home solar and battery setup installed by Expert Electrical, and I couldn't be more satisfied. From start to finish, their service was prompt and professional. The consultation process was thorough and made the entire experience simple and straightforward.I chose a 13.2kW array with Jinko Tiger Neo N-type solar panels, a Fronius GEN24 10kW inverter, and a BYD HVM 16.6kW battery. The quality of the product and installation was top-notch, standing out among other companies I considered. Not only did they offer great pricing, but their attention to detail and commitment to excellence truly impressed me.I highly recommend Expert Electrical for anyone looking to install a solar system.
An efficient installation all done as quoted, on time, on the day as advised. Clean and tidy and extremely helpful in all aspects, like setting up app and dealing with grants etc etc.

The whole team at Expert Electrical are excellent. The initial quote with Lee the sales representative was very informative and left us with no questions about what would be best for us.The installation was quickly arranged and they were flexible around us getting our roof painted at the same time. The install team were very polite and kept us informed of what they were doing and cleaned up after themselves. They were always bang on time for when they said they would be coming as well.The customer service before and after has also been great. After install I was shown all the features of the system and they explained some troubleshooting I could do if anything went wrong. Any other questions I’ve had have been quickly answered by Martina or Emma from the office.I would happily recommend expert electrical to anyone.

During the quote process Francis explained what the best system for my needs would be.Everything organised as well as checking to ensure that I could keep the government feed in tariff.All of the necessary paperwork organised.Expert Electrical kept me informed about each step. After paying a small deposit I was contacted to arrange a suitable date for installation.Caleb came to do the installation he was on time, polite and tidy.I could not fault anything at any step of the process.I would certainly recommend Expert Electrical to anyone looking for a reputable efficient solar installer.

The solar quoting process was just brilliant and hassle free. There was a "no obligation" site visit. The gentleman, Mr Lee was good, and clear in his explanations. The installation day went well with three of them doing a fantastic job. No marks, perfect installation, I can say! Overall great experience with Expert Electricals.
My experience with expert Electrical was very good from the initial enquiry to installation.
The team turned up exactly as promised and straight on with job The team were polite and helpful through out .
Great communication from Expert Electrical from enquiry to installation. The pricing was mid-range but the service was professional. Satisfied with panels and battery install and operation.

The quoting process was great, very honest and open discussion about all aspects, the price, the process. All questions satisfactorily ansered.The installation was seamless, Maurice continuously discussed all aspects with me and helped me through the entire process. There were no surprises or hidden costs.The whole process was great. I love my 10kW system, and I'm hooked on the inverter website.
Great service from start to finish , very professional all round , great company to deal with

My initial reason for using Expert Electrical came from the sales process. The representative at the time approached the sale from a technical aspect and was relentless in finding the right outcome that was suitable to my situation.Following from there, the installation was impressively quick. A 13.2 kW system installed from 7 am to 2pm.The guys installing were professional  courteous and efficientl. Kudos to Caleb and the team.

Expert Electrical recently installed a 13.2Kw array of panels on our home along with a 10Kw 3-phase inverter. The quoting process with Expert Electrical was very good with a sales person visiting our property and providing a couple of options for a system. They were able to answer all of our questions gave advice when needed.The installation process went smoothly. The installer, Jacob, was very professional, polite and and easy to work with.  There are always challenges during any installation and he was able to deal with any issues as they arose to complete the installation.We are very satisfied with the work and the system is performing very well. Would definitely recommend the Fronius Symo inverter.Would also definitely use Expert Electrical again and recommend them for your installation.

The quoting process was very simple for the system I had in mind, I had plenty of questions I prepared and about all of them were respectably answered with transparency and respect to the market and the company's past experience. The process had a focus on helping me understand to make the most out of my solar system beyond the installation, this was a surprise as all the other quotes I had cared only about selling the product.The installers were polite, I had zero hassles with talking or asking any questions I had when I got an opportunity to ask, the guys were straight forward with anything they needed to tell me or for anything I wanted to say, other than that they were dedicated on working on the system within a timely manner. The panel and racks on the roof were installed fairly well from what I got to look at from time to time. The installers made sure to follow standards such as for the small portion of the roof facing north, it was fitted with 6 out of the 15 panels, the installers had those panels orientated in landscape to make most of the space while working within the exclusion zones between the bottom panels and the gutter. By the time the installation was done there was a decent effort to tidy up the area with no sizeable rubbish left behind.Communication and customer service has been the strong point with discussing on a solar system with this installer. Throughout the process, I was provided with any email, calls or text regarding to the installation and quote ranging from the installers to both my power provider and distributors. From dealing with the quoting process to follow-up calls to the installation and finally to post installation, the customer service and communication from my sales rep, caller and installer have all been respectable, clear and transparent.
Outstanding service and communication throughout the process.Highly recommend Expert Electrical for a quality solar installation.

From start to finish, these guys were awesome.I found them on Solar quotes and after being put in touch with them, I had a call from someone asking if they could come to my house to see what and how it could be installed. (Incidentally, the only company who did)Lee arrived on time and had a look around, he found a few additional items that were required to be installed and made me aware of what they were, why it needed to be installed and how much it would cost, this is a huge thing for me not having hidden costs being sprung on me at the last minute. Lee was at my house for 20 minutes, and after he had left, I had a quote within 5 minutes!After engaging Expert Electrical and paying my deposit, they came to my house and installed the whole system with no fuss, they were a nice bunch of guys who got on with the job and cleaned up after they had finished. Once the installation was completed, they took the time to run me through the system, how it works and how to isolate it. They also told me how to ensure the system stays in good condition and what maintenance was required.I was so impressed with the whole process and have asked them for more work to be carried out on my house as they deal with A/C installations also!Very happy,Thanks guys. Tim Cox

We had our solar installed on our residential property within a month of first contact. Lee the sales person was easily contactable, friendly, honest and very knowledgeable. The installation team on the day consisted of 4 men who were able to install the whole system and 36 panels in one day. They were friendly, open to questions, efficient and left the place spotless. System works great and love the app for tracking our usage. Feels great to run the clothes dryer guilt free. It has already hugely reduced our electricity bills, in line with what we were advised. Would recommend this company.

After receiving 4 quotes for a new solar system we decided to go with Expert Electrical. They were the best price and provided excellent quality solar panels and inverter. We researched the different brands that each quote provided before making our decision. As soon as we accepted their quote they immediately got the ball rolling and contacted Energex to lodge an application for the new system. Expert electrical was quick to organise the installation date and we are very happy with the results and our new solar system. The staff are professional and kept in touch with us during the whole process and we would have no hesitation in recommending Expert Electrical for anyone wanting a new solar system.

Quality of work was great, which is why we are giving 5 stars! Professional, clean and tidy install.Only thing was they took a little while to actually schedule us in, we got a bit lost in the numbers. From accepting the quote to being booked was a bit delayed, but the overall product is worth it!

Very helpful right from the get-go. Kept in touch with various options, helpful in choosing the right system.Installation guys great. Arrived right on time (tad early actually) and got stuck right in.Got the system grid connection organised. Cleaned up after. They all worked good together. Friendly, great to have them here.

The quotation process provided plenty of details to understand what was included. The installers arrived on time, were very polite and completed the job efficiently with minimal intrusion. All the arrangements with the grid supplier were taken care of which made the process easy.

We had a great experience with Expert Electrical installing solar panels. The initial communication and quote from Lee, was professional, timely and competitive.Caleb and his team arrived on time and were friendly and professional during the installation process.Would highly recommended this company.

From sales to install Expert Electrical were awesome to deal with, it didn't feel like the typical slimy solar company trying to squeeze you for all your dollars. I had my quote adjusted a couple of times and any concerns were always promptly answered with a very short delay.Expert promised a very good lead time considering the summer install and ultimately delivered on this, even earlier then expected. This made the decision between other installers very easy.On the day of the install, the crew arrived with perfect timing and ran like a well oiled machine, considering the size of the system i thought it would have taken much longer. The fellas had it all wrapped up by 11:00am and off i began with my solar savings!Customer service again was fantastic with organizing the grid connection and getting all the other paperwork sorted so i didn't need to really do anything.Fantastic job Expert Electrical, from Sales, to install, to customer service 10/10.

Got a quote from 3 providers from this website.  Unfortunately, i choose the wrong company to start.  After a horrible experience with the other company, I rang Expert Electrical who got me booked in and Solar installed within a matter of weeks.  The only disappointment is that i didn't go with them from the start.  Seamless install, In fact, the installer was fantastic. Called the day before to ask if he could drop some items of as his other job finished early.  He ended up staying until 6pm, just getting himself organised for the next day.  Arrived on time and left everything neat and tidy.  Ran through everything from start to finish.Would not hesitate to recommend Expert Electrical to anyone looking for Solar.  Everyone was great from start to finish and nothing has been an issue.  Organised everything for us and super quick.
The service received was fantastic and the installation made quick and easy, very impressed!

Easy quote and query process.Prompt response to questions.Day of install went as promised.Everything left clean and tidy. Would not have known anyone had been here apart from the system being in place.
Very good customer service , call and email after installation to see if everything was going well.  Installation was done on the day agreed on. Very professional and tidy. Extremely helpful staff,

Expert Electrical are a fantastic family owned small business, and I am glad I chose them as my solar installer. I was warned not to go with Origin for example, as the bigger companies try and lure you in with cheap installs, and higher feed in tariffs, but in the end you get a poor quality install from incompetent contractors.Shannon quoted me on a 10.56KW system with Jinko Panels and Fronius inverter, with a Catch Relay to run the hot water based on energy production. While he didn't originally quote for digital meter which we found out about on the day of the install, he offered a heavily discounted price to what I would have had to pay. Although this resulted in the install having to run over two days, the system was up and running on the second day by 10am. Maurice and Harry (the installers) were very punctual, and tidy, and explained everything I needed to know about how the system would run. I'm very happy with the product and am generating more than what I need, and hopefully takes off a decent chuck on the next bill!

I found from quoting to installation of my system a simple easy process the office staff keep you informed and the installer are a great team, they were recommended to me by someone else and i would recommend them as well.thanks team expert electrical.
A great product at a great price. From the quote to installation was less than 2 weeks and the guys that installed my system had on and working in  less than 5 hours, would highly recommend thiem!

The process of installing solar was made easy from the get go. The initial consultation was great as Lee came to inspect the house to find the best spot for the panels. He also gave multiple product options as well as a break down of how the system would perform over the years and answered any questions that I had.On the day of installation Maurice and Harrison arrived early to do a shade check of the morning sun. Installation was fast and to a good standard. The team also organised the connection to our energy provider, making the entire process seamless.Overall I would say it has been great value for money and I would highly recommend Expert Electrical to anyone considering a solar installation

Expert Electrical installed solar panels and a battery seamlessly. Their professionalism, expertise, and efficiency were outstanding. They explained everything thoroughly and ensured the system was tailored to our needs. The installation was flawless, and we're already seeing significant energy savings. Highly recommend!A big call out to the exceptional installation from Maurice and Harrison, true professionals that listen to the customer and really do take pride in their work, some of the best trades I've ever had the pleasure of working with.
Great team, good communication and really cared about the the system being installed as efficiently as possible. Highly recommend

From the callout for a quote, the installation, the whole process was a breeze for Expert Electrical. Shannon turned up on time for the quote, answered my questions and concerns and the price very competitive. Installation day Morris and the boys turned up on time and all went like clockwork, they know their trade. The site was left clean, all paper work done and I am now enjoying free power. Give Expert Electrical the opportunity to install your solar. I am total satisfied with all.  Thanks Paul. Carina

The salesman was delayed but gave us prior notice. He had done his homework and did not try and sell us the more expensive products. The installation was done quickly and at a time that suited us. We were novices when it came to solar installation but were guided throughout the process
Expert electrical were great company to deal with and delivery was on time.

On 1 March, this incident was reported to EE with photos provided. I was requested to supply photos of the patio roof before the installation, which I don't have. However, given that I commenced a planned renovation in October 2022 (including full roof maintenance), I can supply the contact details of the roofer and builder to verify that the patio roof did not have any prior damage. I attributed the damage to walking on the roof given that the dents were mostly presented in the area closest to the main roof. Furthermore, the lack of dirt on the kinks suggested that they were recently created (the patio was installed for 8 years and the roof has not been cleaned). Despite numerous follow-ups with admin, I did not have an opportunity to speak with the owners until 12th April. In the meantime, I hired a roof assessor and commenced organising quotes. To organise the quotes, I called over 20 roofers and even posted a job on HiPages in a desperate attempt to get responses as it is a very challenging task to hire a reliable roofer in Brisbane currently. I was rejected by most of them given that the job is too small and they are booked out for the next 3-6 months. The quotes I received ranged between $2000 to $5000. After speaking with them on 12 April, he agreed to pay up to $2500 for the repair and rejected the need to sight further evidence (e.g. roof report). Although I would prefer EE to send their roofer (covered under their Public Liability Insurance), I agreed as I am keen to get this resolved.I am aware of transferring the risk of damage to my newly installed cat netting (with 10 years warranty), outdoor blinds, gutters and downpipe by hiring my roofer. Therefore, I requested $2500 to cover my time spent time and funds spent to organise quotes and a roof inspection. Requested a signed form stating EE has paid for the patio roof to be replaced and any further issues with the roof are not their responsibility. I thought this was fair and agreed. When I received the 'form' on 21 April, I was enraged and shocked. It explicitly states “the releasee doesn’t admit liability with respect to the incident.”  I felt insulted when my incident was referred to as "ït was alleged...", which is interpreted as extortion. (EE has not supplied any evidence to demonstrate the patio roof had prior damage. They claimed that they saw the dents on installation day. If this was the case, wouldn't they, being an experienced and accredited electrician, took a photo or talked to me?) The document presents a lot of contradicting information. If it was extortion, shouldn't I insist on the highest quote of $5000? Why would I install the cat netting, etc.? Furthermore, given that extortion constitutes a Federal crime, I will be discreet without being told, making the confidentiality clause unnecessary. For these reasons, I have rejected the agreement and will pursue further action with the relevant authorities instead. In contrast, I would never pay/compensate anyone if I am adamant about not having any liability.I believe I have done everything right, and have been reasonable in negotiating for a resolution. I am utterly disappointed by EE's response, which says a lot about their business. I should not need to invest so much time, energy or effort in EE's mistakes. I am considering submitting my story to 60 Minutes and A Current Affair.Please refer to the attachments to support this review. Although I have removed all personal details for privacy reasons, I will be providing the full and un-redacted documents to the ACCC, CEC and the Office of Fair Trading.
